title: Test migration of passive historical turn receipts and checkpoint records
outcome: Add direct source-test proof that stored historical turn_begin and turn_checkpoint receipts and checkpoint records survive export/import unchanged and remain healthy passive history.
acceptance: A historical fixture contains valid turn_begin and turn_checkpoint control_operation_results rows plus a canonical turn_checkpoint_event and its control_changes entry, without restoring executable turn operations.
Export/import preserves fixture record ids, canonical bytes, links and relevant receipt rows byte-for-byte, followed by healthy verify_all.
Malformed historical shapes remain refused under the existing doctor/import contract.
